title: My Hero Academia Creator’s New Manga Clearly Deserves a Longer Run
content: My Hero Academia is one of the most successful anime and manga series of all time. Although the main story reached its conclusion two years ago, its popularity only continues to rise thanks to the exceptional story.

title: Pan Dorobō Anime's 2nd Video Reveals More Cast
content: Kadokawa unveiled the second main promotional video and more cast members for the anime of Keiko Shibata 's Pan Dorobō (Bread Thief) picture book on Thursday. The video previews the ending theme song "Pang Pang Pang" by Kyary Pamyu Pamyu : Kana Hanazawa also joins the cast as the narrator.
author: ANN

title: 1 Year Ago, Jujutsu Kaisen Shocked Fans With a Sci-Fi Twist
content: The Jujutsu Kaisen manga reached its controversial ending in September 2024, leaving behind several unanswered questions. The final battle went on for over a year, but the ending didn’t resolve several plot points .
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Forgotten Classic Fantasy Creator Is Returning With a Brand New Series
content: Fan-favorite series, Noragami , reached its conclusion in January 2024 after more than 13 years of serialization. This beloved Shonen fantasy hasn’t returned with a sequel anime season since 2015; it’s more or less forgotten among new anime fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Voice Actress Sumire Uesaka Cancels KyoMAF Appearances After Receiving Email Threats
content: Talent agency Voice Kit announced on Monday that voice actress Sumire Uesaka has received multiple extremely malicious threatening emails, with some containing threats to harm Uesaka. The company stated that it is taking the matter seriously.
